recipes.name: Grilled Eggplant with Citrus Glaze
recipes.description: A savory and tangy dish featuring grilled eggplant glazed with a citrusy mixture of lemon and orange.
recipes.instructions: Start by preheating a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat. Brush the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill the eggplant for about 4-5 minutes on each side, until they are tender and have grill marks. Meanwhile, in a small saucepan over medium heat, combine lemon juice, orange juice, honey, and grated ginger. Bring to a simmer and cook until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Brush the glaze over the grilled eggplant just before serving. Serve warm with extra glaze on the side.

recipes.name: Pineapple and Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: A vibrant and refreshing stir-fry combining the sweetness of pineapple with crunchy broccoli.
recipes.instructions: Take a large wok or frying pan and heat the sesame oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the broccoli and carrot, and stir-fry for 5 minutes until they start to soften. Add the pineapple chunks and cucumber slices, and continue to stir-fry for another 3 minutes. Pour in the soy sauce and stir to coat the vegetables evenly. Cook for an additional 2 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Carrot and Apple Salad with Lemon Dressing
recipes.description: A refreshing and crunchy salad with a tangy lemon dressing, perfect for a light meal or side dish.
recipes.instructions: In a large salad bowl, combine the shredded carrots, apple slices, halved grapes, and diced cucumber. In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to create the dressing. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Serve chilled.
